decision.reason: Original TechCrunch reported a clandestine recording device planted in an executive conference room and discovered through an internal investigation. Independently scoped buyer task: physical meeting-room equipment inspection and incident evidence tracking; actual buying demand and competitors not yet validated.

opportunities.idea_name: Meeting Room Device Integrity Sweep Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Record who checked executive meeting-room devices and close suspicious peripheral findings with evidence
opportunities.target_customer: Enterprise physical security and information security coordinators
opportunities.product_mechanism: Room inventory -> numbered TV/USB/device and access checklist -> dated manual inspection -> suspicious attachment case -> human approval and evidence export
opportunities.why_now: A reported discovery of an unauthorized USB-connected recording device in a corporate executive room on 13 Oct 2026 highlights the inspection/incident evidence gap, not proof of universal demand.
opportunities.before_state: Office device inventories and periodic sweeps are scattered in spreadsheets, photographs and vendor tickets.
opportunities.after_state: A versioned per-room manual hardware check and escalation case record shows changes and accountable closures.

source_check.rss_title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room - TechCrunch
